control_name: Life OLI_LU code lists are valid and current
control_objective: Every coded value carried on a Life & Annuity message uses a valid OLI_LU code drawn from the current ACORD OLI code list, so that enumerated values are interpreted consistently across carriers, BGAs, and distribution platforms.
risk_addressed: Invalid or stale OLI_LU codes cause downstream consumers to misinterpret enumerated values or reject transactions, producing incorrect product, status, and party classifications and breaking automated processing of Life & Annuity business.

required_data_elements.business_definition: An OLI_LU coded value used on a Life & Annuity message.
The version of the ACORD OLI code list registered in the data dictionary.

method.summary: Check OLI_LU code usages against the current ACORD OLI code list, counting invalid usages and confirming the registered code list version is current.
steps: Resolve the current ACORD OLI code list version from the data dictionary.
Extract OLI_LU code usages from registered Life & Annuity schemas.
Validate each code usage against the current OLI code list.
Count invalid OLI code usages and confirm the code list version is current.
method.sampling_rule: Check all OLI_LU code usages present in the registered Life & Annuity schemas.
method.fallback_logic: If the data dictionary or schema registry is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any invalid OLI_LU code usage is a data-dictionary exception; a non-current code list version is a warning.
thresholds.pass_tolerance: 0 invalid OLI codes and current code list
thresholds.warning_threshold: OLI code list version not current
thresholds.escalation_threshold: 1 or more invalid OLI code usages

pass_criteria: OLI code list version is current.
warning_criteria: OLI code list version is not current.
fail_criteria: One or more invalid OLI_LU code usages.
exception_handling: Refresh the OLI code list to the current ACORD release and re-validate.

assertions.description: OLI code list version is current.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter against the latest ACORD OLI release.

actions_on_fail: Notify Data Architect and Enterprise Architect
